--- original

@@ -0,0 +1,23 @@
+---
+assignees:
+- claude-code
+position_column: todo
+position_ordinal: '8480'
+title: Run each compaction summarizer call as a queue item on the queue of its own container
+---
+## Why
+
+Now the flash-tier summarizer runs under the gate of the CALLING model, not of the flash container. `performAutoCompaction` builds it from `profile.flash.container.makeSession(...)` (`Session/RoutedSessionActorCompaction.swift:119-129`) while the turn holds its own model's gate. A flash generation of another session can thus run at the same time on the flash model. This is a defect.
+
+With the executor-level queue, a backend made by the flash container gets the flash queue. Thus most of the fix comes from the queue task. This task proves it and covers each compaction path.
+
+## What to do
+
+1. Check each compaction path: turn-start compaction, compaction between passes (tool-result boundary), ceiling-stop compaction, overflow retry, and the caller `compact(...)` (`RoutedSessionActorCompaction.swift:78-87`). Each summarizer call must be one queue item on the queue of the container that runs it, and must not wait while its own session holds a place on the same queue (self-deadlock).
+2. Update the doc comment at `RoutedSessionActorCompaction.swift:89-91` ("The caller must already hold ... a generationGate permit").
+
+## Acceptance Criteria
+
+- [ ] A test shows the flash summarizer waits on the flash queue: a flash pass of another session and the summarizer never overlap.
+- [ ] A test shows the own-model summarizer, called between two passes of a turn, completes (no self-deadlock).
+- [ ] A cancel during a summarizer wait for a queue place cancels the turn (`isTurnCancelled` path). #generation-queue
\ No newline at end of file
